αἰνῶς: αἰνῶς — terribly, exceedingly; adv. from αἰνός, intensifying a verb of feeling: αἰνῶς δείδοικα ’I am terribly afraid’ · also intensifying a verb of likeness: ’terribly like’ (αἰνῶς … ἔοικεν ’is terribly like’)
αἳ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. pl. · also demonstrative ὁ, ἡ, τό (in Homer a pronoun), fem. nom. pl.: ’they’; αἳ μέν … αἳ δέ ’some … others’ · also fem. nom. pl. with a dual verb (a dual subject, two goddesses): ’the two’
αἴ: εἰ — if; conditional conj., epic/dialectal by-form αἰ (used before κε)
αἶσαν: αἶσα — due measure, portion, lot; fem. acc. sg. (κατ’ αἶσαν ’according to due measure’; ὑπὲρ αἶσαν ’beyond due measure’)
αὐτίκ: αὐτίκα (elided αὐτίκ’) — at once, immediately; adv.
αὐτοῦ: αὐτός — self; masc. gen. sg.: ’of himself, him’ · also the adverb αὐτοῦ, ’there, on the spot’
αὐτὰρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
αὖ: αὖ — again, in turn, back; adv., shorter form of αὖτε
βίην: βίη — strength, might, force; fem. acc. sg., accusative of respect: ’in might’ · also periphrasis for a person, direct object: ’the might of Priam’ (= Priam himself) · also periphrasis for a person, acc. subject of an infinitive: ’the might of Heracles’ (= Heracles himself) · also periphrasis for a person, governed by ἀμφί: ’around the might of Diomedes’ (= around Diomedes himself)
βεβήκει: βαίνω — go, step; plpf. 3 sg. with simple past force (Homeric pluperfect): ’had gone, was gone’
γ: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle (elided γ’)
γένηται: γίγνομαι — become, come to be; aor. subj. 3 sg., in a conditional clause after εἴ ποτε: ’if there ever comes to be’ · also in an indefinite relative clause with κε: ’proves, turns out’ (κρείσσων γένηται ’proves the stronger’) · also after ὅπως in an indirect question: ’how … may come about, turn out’ · also in a prohibition or negative wish after μή: ’let it not become’
γαῖα: γαῖα — earth, land; fem. nom. sg. (epic = Attic γῆ)
γενέσθαι: γίγνομαι — become, come to be; aor. inf. mid.: ’to come about, be made’ · also with περί + gen.: ’to be superior to’ · also aor. inf. mid. after φημί, predicate: ’to be, to have become’
γυναικί: γυνή — woman, wife; fem. dat. sg., after ἀμφί: ’about a woman’
γόον: γόος — wailing, lament; masc. acc. sg.
γύναι: γυνή — woman, wife; fem. voc. sg., in address: ’woman!’
δ: δέ (elided δ’) — and, but · also the elided suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (Ἄργος δ’ ’to Argos’)
δάκρυ: δάκρυ — tear, tears; neut. acc. sg., object of χέω: ’shedding tears’ · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’a tear’ · also neut. acc. sg., object of ἀπομόρξατο ’wiped away’
δέξατο: δέχομαι — receive, take; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= Attic ἐδέξατο)
δή: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δήϊον: δήϊος — hostile, destructive (of war or a foe); masc./neut. acc. sg., epic (= Attic δήιος)
δαιμονίη: δαιμόνιος — strange, puzzling, uncanny; fem. voc. sg., epic -η (= Attic -α), reproachful address: ’strange one’
δαιμόνι: δαιμόνιος — strange, puzzling, odd; voc. sg., elided (δαιμόνι’ = δαιμόνιε), as address: ’strange one’ (gentle or chiding, tone uncertain)
δεινὸν: δεινός — dread, terrible; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’dreadfully, fearsomely’
διί: Ζεύς — Zeus; masc. dat. sg. (Διί, from the stem Δι-)
δυσμενέεσσιν: δυσμενής — hostile, ill-disposed; masc. dat. pl., epic -έεσσιν (= Attic -έσι)
δόμους: δόμος — house, hall; masc. acc. pl., object of a verb of reaching: ’halls’ (plural for one dwelling)
δὲ: δέ — and, but; connective particle · also the enclitic suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (οἶκον δὲ ’homeward’)
δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δῖον: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; standing epithet; masc. acc. sg.
εἰπὼν: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.
εἰς: εἰς — into, to; prep. + acc. · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also + acc. of respect: ’in’ (εἰς ὦπα ’in face’)
εἴη: εἰμί — be; pres. opt. 3 sg.: ’it might be, he might be’; potential with κεν: ’it would be’ · also in a wish after εἴθε: ’would that it were’
εἴποι: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. opt. 3 sg.
εἵλετο: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg. mid., augmented: ’took up (for himself)’
εἵνεκα: ἕνεκα — because of, for the sake of; prep. + gen., often after its noun; epic prothetic ε- (εἵνεκα)
εἶπε: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. 3 sg., without movable ν (= Attic εἶπεν)
εὖτ: εὖτε (elided εὖτ’) — when, whenever; temporal conj. (with ἄν + subj.) · also with an aor. indic. in a simile: ’when’ (εὖτ’ … κατέχευεν ’when he has poured’)
ζεὺς: Ζεύς — Zeus, king of the gods; nom. sg.
ζωὸν: ζωός — alive, living; masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic ζῶν): ’alive’
θ: τε (elided and aspirated θ’ before a rough breathing) — and; connective particle
θαλερὸν: θαλερός — blooming, vigorous, swelling; adj., neut. nom. sg.: θαλερὸν δάκρυ ’an abundant tear’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a masc. noun: ’blooming, in his prime’
θεοειδής: θεοειδής — godlike in form (θεός + εἶδος); adj. (2-term.), masc. nom. sg.
θεοὶ: θεός — god; nom. pl. · also voc. pl. (same form): ’you gods!’
θεοῖσι: θεός — god; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic θεοῖς)
θυμόν: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul, anger; acc. sg. · also the life that leaves the body: ’life’ (θυμὸν ἀποπνείων ’breathing out his life’)
θυμὸς: θυμός — heart, spirit, desire; nom. sg.
θυμῷ: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; dat. sg.
κάρη: κάρη — head; neut. acc. sg., acc. of respect: ’as to the head’ (κάρη κομόωντας ’long-haired’) · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’head’ (κάρη ὤμοισιν ἐπείη ’may the head be on the shoulders’) · also neut. acc. sg., direct object: ’head’ (ἐστήριξε κάρη ’planted her head’)
κέ: κε(ν) — epic particle (= Attic ἄν); accented before an enclitic · with αἴ + subj.: ’if perhaps’ · with a relative + fut. indic.: ’who will, in that event’ · also εἰς ὅ κέ + fut. or short-vowel subj.: ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κέ σ’ … ποιήσεται ’until he makes you’) · also + fut. indic. in a main clause: ’will’ (καί κέ τις … ἐρέει ’someone will say’) · also ὄφρά κέ + subj.: ’until’ (… κέ … ἐνείκω ’until I bring’) · also ὥς κέ + opt., in a wish: ’so … might’
κέλευε: κελεύω — command, order; pres. imper. 2 sg. · also impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐκέλευε): ’he gave orders’
κέν: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); accented before an enclitic
κακὸν: κακός — bad, evil, harmful; neut. acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., ’a coward, a base man’ (κακὸν ὣς δειδίσσεσθαι ’to frighten like a coward’) · also masc. acc. sg., adj. with a noun: ’evil’ (κακὸν οἶτον ’an evil doom’) · also neut. nom. sg., predicate noun: ’an evil’
κακὸς: κακός — bad, base, cowardly; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’base’ · also masc. nom. sg., attributive: ’evil’ (πόλεμος κακός ’evil war’)
κατέδυ: δύω — sink, enter, go down into; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, augmented (κατά … ἔδυ): of the sun ’set, went down’
κατέθηκεν: κατατίθημι — put down, lay down; aor. 3 sg. act. (ν-movable): ’laid down’
κατέρεξεν: καταρρέζω — stroke, caress; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable, epic κατέρεξε(ν) (= Attic κατέρρεξε)
κατὰ: κατά — down, throughout, along; + acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (κατὰ … ἔκηα ’burned up’) · also + acc. in κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’ · also + acc. of purpose, ’for’ (κατὰ δαῖτα ’for a feast’) · also + acc. of respect, ’in’ (κατὰ θυμόν ’in heart’) · also + acc., distributive: ’by’ (κατὰ φῦλα ’by tribes’) · also + acc. of place: ’in, among’ (κατὰ ὑσμίνας ’in the battles’) · also κατὰ σφέας ’by themselves, apart’ · also + acc. of the place struck: ’in, on’ (κατὰ δεξιὸν ὦμον ’in the right shoulder’) · also + acc., ’into, toward’ (κατὰ πληθὺν ’toward the throng’)
κε: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); with the subj. in purpose and general clauses · also + subj. in a temporal or conditional clause: ’whenever’, ’if’ · also + fut. indic. in a main clause: ’shall’ (κε μελήσεται ’will concern’) · also + opt., potential: ’would’ (τώ κε … ἠμύσειε ’then would collapse’) · also with an impf. indic., past potential: ’would have’ (κε … ἔπασχον ’I would have suffered’)
κεν: κε(ν) — epic particle (= Attic ἄν); with the opt., potential: ’might, would’; with the subj. in conditions after εἰ, αἰ · also + subj. or fut. indic. in a main or relative clause: ’shall’ (’I shall take’; ’to whom I come’) · also + subj. in a general relative clause: ’whatever’ (ὅττί κεν εἴπῃς) · also with a past indic., contrary to fact: ’would have’ (ἔνθά κεν … ἐτύχθη) · also with an impf. indic., past potential: ’would be’ (κεν … κέρδιον ἦεν ’it would be better’) · also + subj. in a temporal clause after εἰς ὅ: ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … μάχωνται ’until they fight’) · also εἴ κεν + opt., in a condition: ’if … should’ · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὥς: ’so that … may’ · also + subj. in a temporal clause after ὅτε: ’whenever’ (ὅτε κεν … ἵκωμαι ’whenever I come’)
κιχήσατο: κιχάνω — reach, come upon, find; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic, unaugmented
κλέος: κλέος — fame, renown; neut. nom. sg., subject: ’fame’ · also neut. acc. sg., object: ’a report’ · also neut. acc. sg., object: ’fame, a good name’ (κλέος … ἄροιτο ’win fame’)
κλυτὰ: κλυτός — famous, renowned; neut. acc. pl., with δώματ’
κονίῃσι: κονία — dust; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic κονίαις)
κορυθαίολος: κορυθαίολος — with glancing, flashing helmet; masc. nom. sg., stock epithet of Hector
κρατὸς: κάρη — head; gen. sg. κρατός, from the by-form κράς, gen. of separation: ’from his head’
κρητῆρα: κρητήρ — mixing-bowl (for wine and water); masc. acc. sg.
κυδιόων: κυδιάω — glory, exult in one’s pride (κῦδος); pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic κυδιῶν)
κόλπον: κόλπος — bosom, hollow, gulf (of the sea); masc. acc. sg.
κόλπῳ: κόλπος — bosom, lap, fold of a garment; masc. dat. sg.
κῆρ: κῆρ — heart; neut. nom./acc. sg.; as accusative of respect, χωόμενος κῆρ ’incensed in heart’ · also κήρ — doom, death-fate; fem. acc. sg., elided (κῆρ’ = κῆρα): ’death-fate’
λίην: λίαν — very much, exceedingly; adv., Ionic λίην (= Attic λίαν)
λαὸς: λαός — people, host, army; masc. nom. sg.
μ: ἐγώ — I; encl. acc. sg., elided (μ’ = με): ’me’ · also = dat. μοι, elided before a vowel, with a dat. participle: ’to me’ (ἥ μ’ οἴῳ ἔρροντι συνήντετο, συναντάω + dat.)
μάλ: μάλα (elided μάλ’) — very, very much, by all means; adv.
μάλα: μάλα — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
μάλιστα: μάλα — very, much; superl. adv. μάλιστα: ’most of all, especially’ · also ’for the most part, mostly’ (μάλιστα ἦμαρ ’the greater part of the day’)
μάχεσθαι: μάχομαι — fight (epic μαχέομαι); pres. inf. (Attic μάχεσθαι), + dat. ’fight against’ · also with ἀμφί + dat. of the cause: ’fight over’ (ἀμφ’ Ἑλένῃ … μάχεσθαι ’to fight over Helen’)
μάχης: μάχη — battle, fight; fem. gen. sg., after ἀπάνευθε · also fem. gen. sg., governed by εἰδότε: ’skilled in all (fighting)’ · also fem. gen. sg. of separation, with ἔσχοντο: ’from the fighting’ · also fem. gen. sg., object of ἀντιβολῆσαι: ’to meet (the battle)’ · also fem. gen. sg. of place, with ἐπ’ ἀριστερά: ’on the left of the battle’ · also fem. gen. sg., governed by ἀδαήμονι: ’ignorant of (battle)’ · also fem. gen. sg. of separation, with ἐξαποδίωμαι: ’out of the battle’
μέγα: μέγας — great, huge; neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’greatly’ (μέγα νήπιοι ’greatly foolish’)
μέγας: μέγας — great, big; masc. nom. sg.
μέλει: μέλω — be a care, be of concern (impersonal; dat. of the person, nom. of the thing); pres. 3 sg.: ’is a care to’
μένος: μένος — force, might, spirit, rage; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’might’
μή: μή — not; the negative of wish, command, fear and condition (where οὐ is the negative of fact) · also ’lest’, with the subj. · also ’lest’ with the opt. (μή … δευοίατο ’lest they lack’) · also ’lest’ with a dual verb in -ετον: ’lest the two … hang back’
μεγάροισιν: μέγαρον — hall, great chamber; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
μελήσει: μέλω — be a care to; fut. 3 sg. act. (impersonal + dat.): ’will be a care (to)’
μετὰ: μετά — among, with, after; + dat./acc./gen. · also an adverb, ’among them’, or a preverb in tmesis
μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)
μοί: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg., accented μοί before the enclitic that follows: ’to me, for me’
μοι: ἐγώ — I; encl. dat. sg.: ’to me, for me’ · also dat. of possession or interest: ’my’ (μοι ἵπποι ’my horses’)
μοῖραν: μοῖρα — due share, what is fitting, portion, fate; fem. acc. sg. (κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’)
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’: οὐ μὲν δή ’surely not’
νέον: νέος — young, new; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’lately, just now’
ναιετάοντας: ναιετάω — dwell, be inhabited; pres. part. masc. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ναιετῶντας): ’inhabited’
νόσφιν: νόσφιν — apart, far off, away; adv. · also prep. + gen.: ’apart from, without’
οἳ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. pl., ’they’ · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. pl., ’who’
οἵ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. pl. · also demonstrative, with γε: ’they’ (οἵ γ’ ἀθέριζον) · also encl. dat. sg. οἱ, accented before a following enclitic: ’to him’ (δέ οἵ ἐστ’ ’and his … is’)
οἶδα: οἶδα — know; perf. with pres. sense, 1 sg.: ’I know’
οἶκον: οἶκος — house, household; masc. acc. sg., with the suffix -δε: οἶκον δέ ’homeward, to his house’ · also masc. acc. sg. without -δε, after κατά: ’in the house, at home’
οὐ: οὐ — not; neg. adv. · also in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ (οὐ γὰρ δὴ … ἐβούλευσας; ’did you not devise …?’)
οὐδ: οὐδέ (elided οὐδ’) — and not, nor, not even
οὐδέ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj.
οὐδὲ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj. (grave, mid-clause form)
οὐκ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a vowel with smooth breathing (οὐχ before a rough breathing)
οὔ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ · also the plain negative adverb in a declarative statement, with no question implied: ’not’
οὔτ: οὔτε (elided οὔτ’) — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.
οὔτε: οὔτε — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.: ’neither … nor’
οὗ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; masc./neut. gen. sg.: ’whose, of which’ · ἐξ οὗ ’since, from the time when’ · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν, masc./neut. gen. sg.: ’his own’ (οὗ πατρός ’his own father’)
πάντα: πᾶς — all, every; neut. acc. pl.: ’all (things)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a name: ’all (through the whole of)’ (Αἰγιαλόν τ’ ἀνὰ πάντα) · also neut. acc. pl. adverbially: ’in every respect, in all things’ · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with ταῦτα: ’all’ (ταῦτα … πάντα ’all these things’)
πάρις: Πάρις — Paris, son of Priam, also called Alexander; masc. nom. sg.
πάϊς: παῖς — child, son; masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic παῖς)
παιδὸς: παῖς — child, son; masc. gen. sg.
παῖδ: παῖς — child, daughter, son; fem. acc. sg., elided (παῖδ’ = παῖδα): ’child, daughter’ (παῖς is common gender) · also masc. acc. sg., elided: ’boy, son’ (παῖδ’ ὀρφανικόν ’the boy an orphan’)
πεδίοιο: πεδίον — plain; neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), gen. of the space traversed: ’over the plain’
πεποιθώς: πείθω — persuade; perf. πέποιθα trust, rely on (+ dat.); perf. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’trusting in’
πεποιθὼς: πείθω — persuade; perf. πέποιθα: trust, rely on (+ dat.); perf. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’trusting’
περ: περ — even, though; enclitic particle, concessive or intensive; εἴ περ ’even if’
περγάμου: Πέργαμος — Pergamos, the high citadel of Troy; gen. sg., gen. of the place looked down from, with ἐκκατιδών: ’from Pergamos’
ποθι: ποθι — somehow, somewhere; epic enclitic adv. (= Attic πού)
ποικίλα: ποικίλος — many-coloured, intricately wrought; neut. nom. pl., agreeing with τεύχεα · also neut. acc. pl., agreeing with ἅρματα: ’intricate (chariot)’
πολέες: πολύς — much, many; masc. nom. pl., epic πολέες (= Attic πολλοί)
πολέμοιο: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
πολέμου: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. gen. sg., after ἀποπαύεο: ’from war’ · also gen. sg. of separation after ἐκ: ’out of the war’ · also masc. gen. sg., after ἄτερ: ’without war’ · also masc. gen. sg., after εἶκε: ’from war’ (εἶκε … πολέμου ’withdraw from war’)
πολλὰς: πολύς — much, many; fem. acc. pl., accent grave mid-clause
πολλὸν: πολύς — much; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, epic (= Attic πολύ): ’by far’
πολὺν: πολύς — much, many; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with λαόν: ’a great host’ · also masc. acc. sg. agreeing with χρόνον: ’a long (time)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ὅμιλον: ’a great (throng)’ (πολὺν καθ’ ὅμιλον ’through the great throng’)
ποτ: ποτέ — once, at some time, ever; enclitic adv., elided (ποτ’ = ποτέ)
ποτέ: ποτέ — once, at some time, ever; encl. adv.
ποταμοῖο: ποταμός — river; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
πρίαμος: Πρίαμος — Priam, king of Troy; masc. nom. sg.
πρίν: πρίν — before, sooner; adv.; and conj. + inf., ’before’; πρὶν … πρίν ’not … until’
πριάμοιο: Πρίαμος — Priam, king of Troy; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
προσέειπε: προσεῖπον — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic προσεῖπε)
προσέειπεν: προσεῖπον — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted, augment ἐ- kept (= Attic προσεῖπε)
προσέφη: πρόσφημι — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg.
πρότερος: πρότερος — before, first, earlier; masc. nom. sg., predicative: ’first (to)’ · also predicate, ’earlier-born, elder’ (ὁ δ’ ἅμα πρότερος ’and he was the elder’) · also attributive, ’former’ (πρότερος πόσις ’former husband’)
πρώτοισι: πρῶτος — first, foremost; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις): ’the foremost’
πρὸς: πρός — towards, to; prep. + acc. · also + gen.: ’from, at the hands of’ (πρὸς Τρώων ’from the Trojans’) · also + gen. of witnesses: ’before, in the sight of’ (πρὸς θεῶν ’before the gods’) · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (πρὸς … ἔειπεν ’addressed’) · also adv., ’besides’ (πρὸς δ’ … ῥῆξε ’and besides … broke’) · also prep. + dat.: ’on, against’ (πρὸς χρυσῇ περόνῃ ’on a golden brooch’)
πρῶτα: πρῶτος — first; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’first’
πυθέσθαι: πυνθάνομαι — inquire, learn, hear of; aor. inf. mid., epexegetic: αἰσχρὸν … πυθέσθαι ’a shame to hear of’
πόλεμος: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. nom. sg.
πόλλ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl., elided (πόλλ’ = πολλά): ’many’
πόνον: πόνος — toil, labor, trouble; acc. sg.
πόσις: πόσις — husband, spouse; masc. nom. sg. · also πόσις — drink; fem. nom. sg. (βρῶσίς τε πόσις τε ’food and drink’)
πότνια: πότνια — lady, mistress, revered; fem. nom. sg., title of a goddess or queen
πᾶσι: πᾶς — all, every; masc./neut. dat. pl.
σ: σύ — you (sg.); encl. acc. sg., elided (σ’ = σε): ’you’
σέθεν: σύ — you (sg.); gen. sg., epic σέθεν (= Attic σοῦ)
σεῖο: σύ — you (sg.); gen. sg., epic σεῖο (= Attic σοῦ), after περί: ’about you’ · also gen. of comparison after a comparative: ’than you’ (σεῖο … ὀλοώτερος ’deadlier than you’)
σεῦ: σύ — you; gen. sg., epic σεῦ (= Attic σοῦ)
σοὶ: σύ — you (sg.); dat. sg.: ’to, for you’
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a general truth; in τ’ ἄρ with a question, ’then’ · also epic τε attached to ἦ, strengthening it: ἦ τ’ ’truly indeed’
τάδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’ · also neut. acc. pl. adverbially: ’in this way’ (τάδε μαίνεται ’rages like this’) · also neut. acc. pl. with a noun: ’this’ (τάδε τόξα ’this bow’)
τέ: τε — and; enclitic connective, accented τέ before the enclitic μιν · also accented before the enclitic οἱ (ἀτάρ τέ οἱ ὄζοι ’but its branches’, τε being the epic particle of what is always so, not translated) · also epic τε attached to ἦ, strengthening it, accented before an enclitic: ἦ τέ σ’ ὀΐω ’I truly suspect you’
τίς: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also indefinite τις after ὅς, written τίς: ’anyone, someone’ (ὅς τίς σφιν … ἡγήσαιτο ’anyone to lead them’) · also indefinite, written τίς: ’someone, one’ (ὡς δ’ ὅτε τίς τε δράκοντα ἰδών ’as when someone, seeing a snake’)
ταρβήσας: ταρβέω — be afraid, fear; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., with οὐ: ’unafraid’
ταχέες: ταχύς — swift, fast; masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ταχεῖς)
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τεύχεα: τεῦχος — armor, gear; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted -εα (= Attic τεύχη)
τεύχεσι: τεῦχος — (pl.) armour, gear; neut. dat. pl.
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. nom./acc. sg. · in ὅ τι, ’whatever, why’ (= ὅτι) · also adverbial acc. with οὐ: ’at all’ (οὔ τι δυνήσεαι ’you will not at all be able’) · also adverbial acc. after εἰ: ’at all’ (εἴ ποτε δή τι … ὤνησας ’if ever you helped at all’) · also neut. acc. sg. with κακόν after μή: ’some’ (μή τι … ῥέξῃ κακὸν ’lest he do some evil’) · also adverbial acc. after μή: ’at all’ (μή τι διατρίβειν ’not to delay at all’) · also neut. acc. sg., object of πάσχω after μή: ’any (harm)’ (μή τι πάθοι ’lest he suffer any harm’)
τινά: τις, τι — someone, something; masc. acc. sg., indefinite, accented before an enclitic: ’a (man)’
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also with a negative: ’any, anyone’ (οὐ … τις ’no one’; οὐδέ τις ’nor any’) · also after the relative ὅς, indefinite: ὅς τις ’whichever, whoever’ · also after ὅς, as an indirect interrogative: ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’ · also after εἰ: ’if anyone’ (εἴ τις …) · also after μή: ’lest any’ (μή τις Δαναῶν ’lest any of the Danaans’)
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοὶ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. pl., ’they’ · also the particle τοι, as in τοὶ γάρ (= τοιγάρ) ’so then, therefore’
τρώεσσι: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic Τρωσί)
τρώεσσιν: Τρῶες — Trojans; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic Τρωσί)
τρώων: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. gen. pl.
τρῶας: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. acc. pl.
τόδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., neut. acc. sg.: ’this’ · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’this’ (αἰσχρὸν τόδε ἐστί)
τόνδε: ὅδε — this, this one; demonstrative pron., masc. acc. sg.: ’this man’
τόσσον: τόσος (epic τόσσος) — so much, so great; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’so much, so greatly’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with λαόν: ’so many’ · also adverbial, correlative with ὅσσον: ’so far’
τὰ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl. · τὰ πρῶτα ’at first’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. acc. pl.: ’which’
τὴν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. sg.: ’her’ · also relative, fem. acc. sg.: ’which’ (τὴν πρῶτον ἐπηπείλησ’ ’which he first threatened’) · also fem. acc. sg. with a noun, demonstrative: ’that’ (τὴν ὁδόν ’that journey’)
τὸ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg., ’this, that’ · also relative, neut. nom. sg.: ’which’ (σκῆπτρον, τὸ … οὔ ποτε φύλλα φύσει) · also neut. acc. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the, that’ (τὸ Πελασγικὸν Ἄργος ’the Pelasgian Argos’) · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’on that account, therefore’ (τὸ καὶ κλαίουσα τέτηκα ’and so I waste away weeping’) · also τὸ πρῶτον, adverbial: ’at first’ (ὡς τὸ πρῶτον ’as at first’) · also τὸ πρίν, adverbial: ’before, formerly’ · also τὸ τέταρτον, adverbial: ’for the fourth time’ · also τὸ πάρος, adverbial: ’as before’
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg., ’him’; with a noun, ’that’ · also relative, ’whom’
φάτνῃ: φάτνη — manger, crib, stall; fem. dat. sg.
φέρει: φέρω — bear, carry; pres. 3 sg. act.: ’carries’
φέροι: φέρω — bring, carry, bear; pres. opt. 3 sg. act., of wish: ’may she carry’
φέρον: φέρω — carry, bear; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἔφερον): ’were carrying’
φίλη: φίλος — dear, one’s own; fem. nom. sg. · also fem. voc. sg., in address: ’dear (bride)’
φίλης: φίλος — dear, one’s own; fem. gen. sg.
φίλον: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. voc. sg., agreeing with τέκος: ’dear (child)’
φίλος: φίλος — dear, beloved; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’dear (to him)’ · also attributive, ’dear’ (φίλος υἱός ’dear son’) · also masc. voc. sg., in address: ’dear (Menelaus)’
φαίδιμος: φαίδιμος — shining, glorious, illustrious; masc. nom. sg., epithet of Hector · also epithet of Ajax (φαίδιμος Αἴας) · also epithet of Glaucus (φαίδιμος υἱός ’glorious son’)
φημι: φημί — say, declare, assert; pres. 1 sg.
φρένα: φρήν — mind, wits, heart; fem. acc. sg.
φωνήσας: φωνέω — utter, raise one’s voice; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having raised his voice’
χέουσα: χέω — pour, shed; pres. part. act. fem. nom. sg.: ’pouring, shedding’
χαλκοχιτώνων: χαλκοχίτων — bronze-shirted, with bronze tunics; masc. gen. pl.
χαῖται: χαίτη — hair of the head, mane; fem. nom. pl.
χθονὶ: χθών — earth, ground; fem. dat. sg.
ἀδελφεὸν: ἀδελφεός — brother (epic form = Attic ἀδελφός); masc. acc. sg.
ἀλέξανδρος: Ἀλέξανδρος — Alexander, the other name of Paris, son of Priam; masc. nom. sg.
ἀλλ: ἀλλά (elided ἀλλ’) — but; well then · also ’except’: ’but only’ (ἀλλ’ οἶοι ’except us two’)
ἀλόχοιο: ἄλοχος — wife, bedfellow; fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἀμείνων: ἀμείνων — better, stronger; masc. nom. sg., comparative of ἀγαθός
ἀμφιπόλοισι: ἀμφίπολος — handmaid, attendant; fem. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
ἀμφὶ: ἀμφί — on both sides, around; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀμφὶ … ἴαχε = ἀμφίαχε ’roared around’) · also prep. + acc., ’around’ (ἀμφὶ ῥέεθρα ’around the streams’) · also prep. + dat. or φιν-case, ’about’ (ἀμφὶ στήθεσφιν ’about the chest’)
ἀνάγκη: ἀνάγκη — necessity, constraint; fem. nom. sg.
ἀνάσσειν: ἀνάσσω — be lord, rule (+ dat.); pres. inf.: ’to rule over’
ἀνδροφόνοιο: ἀνδροφόνος — man-slaying; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἀνὰ: ἀνά — up along, throughout; + acc. (ἀνὰ στρατόν ’throughout the army’) · + dat., ’upon’ (ἀνὰ σκήπτρῳ ’upon a sceptre’) · also adv./preverb in tmesis: ’up, aboard’ (ἀνὰ … εἷσεν ’set aboard’) · also + acc. in ἀνὰ στόμ’ ἔχων ’having on your lips, going on about’
ἀπ: ἀπό (elided ἀπ’) — from, away from; prep. + gen. · also a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀπ’ … ὀμόργνυ = ἀπομόργνυ ’wiped off’)
ἀπαμειβόμενος: ἀπαμείβομαι — answer, reply; pres. part. nom. sg. masc.
ἀπούρας: ἀπαυράω — take away from, rob of; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg. ἀπούρας (a defective verb)
ἀπὸ: ἀπό — from, away from; + gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, separated from its verb (ἀπὸ … ὀλέσσει = ἀπολέσει ’will destroy’; ἀπὸ … δοθείη = ἀποδοθείη ’be given back’)
ἀρεσσόμεθ: ἀρέσκω — appease, make amends, put right; fut. 1 pl. mid., epic -σσ-, elided (ἀρεσσόμεθ’ = ἀρεσσόμεθα): ’we shall put right’
ἀχαιούς: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. acc. pl.
ἀχαιῶν: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἄκρης: ἄκρος — topmost, high; adj., fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic -ᾱς), agreeing with πόλιος: ’of the high (city)’
ἄλγος: ἄλγος — pain, grief; neut. nom. sg.
ἄλλοι: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. pl.
ἄν: ἄν — modal particle marking contingency; with the subj. = future contingency, ’perhaps, may’ · also with the opt., potential: ’would, could’ (οὐκ ἄν τι φέροις ’you could not carry off anything’) · also ὅτ’ ἄν + subj., ’whenever’ (= ὅταν) · also ἀνά with apocope (ἄν τε μάχην = ἀνά τε μάχην): ’up, through’ + acc.
ἄνακτος: ἄναξ — lord, king, master; masc. gen. sg.
ἄνδρεσσι: ἀνήρ — man; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic ἀνδράσι)
ἄνωγεν: ἄνωγα — order, bid; perf. with present force, 3 sg. ἄνωγεν also in past sense (= ἠνώγει): ’ordered’
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, short form ἄρ (elided ἄρ’ before a vowel)
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, then, as it turned out; inferential particle
ἄστυ: ἄστυ — town, city; neut. acc. sg.
ἄϊδι: Ἅιδης (epic also Ἄϊς) — Hades, god of the dead; dat. sg. of Ἄϊς
ἐθέλεις: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing, intend; pres. 2 sg.
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐκλίνθη: κλίνω — bend, lean; aor. pass. 3 sg. with middle sense: ’leaned aside’
ἐλέησε: ἐλεέω — pity, have compassion on; aor. 3 sg. act., + acc.: ’pitied’
ἐμοί: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg., stressed (non-enclitic): ’to me’
ἐμοὶ: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg.: ’to, for me’ · also dat. of possession: ’mine is, I have’ (ἐμοὶ δ’ ὄνομα ’my name is’) · also dat. governed by ὑπό: ’under me’ (ὑπ’ ἐμοὶ δμηθέντα ’subdued under me’)
ἐμὸν: ἐμός — my, mine; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’my’ (ὄνομ’ … ἐμὸν ’my name’; ἐμὸν κῆρ ’my heart’) · also neut. voc. sg., in address: ’my’ (τέκνον ἐμὸν ’my child’)
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)
ἐπευξάμενος: ἐπεύχομαι — pray (to), make a vow; aor. part. mid., masc. nom. sg.
ἐπουρανίοισι: ἐπουράνιος — heavenly, dwelling in heaven; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
ἐπὴν: ἐπήν — when, whenever (= ἐπεὶ ἄν; Attic ἐπάν); conj. + subj.
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (μελαινάων ἐπὶ νηῶν ’toward the black ships’) · also + gen. of time, ’in the time of’ (ἐπὶ προτέρων ἀνθρώπων ’in the time of earlier men’) · also adv., ’next, after’ (ἐπὶ δὲ πλήξιππον Ὀρέστην ’and next Orestes’)
ἐρέει: ἐρέω (epic fut. of εἶπον, = Attic ἐρῶ) — say, tell; fut. 3 sg., uncontracted (= Attic ἐρεῖ)
ἐσθλοὶ: ἐσθλός — good, noble, brave; adj., masc. nom. pl.
ἐσθλόν: ἐσθλός — good, noble, brave; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with κλέος: ’good’
ἐσθλὸς: ἐσθλός — good, noble, brave; masc. nom. sg.: ’good’
ἐσσι: εἰμί — be; pres. 2 sg., epic (= Attic εἶ)
ἐϋζώνοιο: ἐΰζωνος — well-girdled; fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), two-ending adj. with γυναικός
ἐϋκνήμιδας: ἐϋκνήμις — well-greaved, with good greaves; masc. acc. pl., standing epithet of the Achaeans
ἐϋμμελίω: ἐϋμμελίης — with good ash-spear; adj., masc. gen. sg., epic -ω (= Attic -ου)
ἑ: ἕ — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. sg. reflexive/personal pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/-ήν/-ό)
ἑκὼν: ἑκών — willing, of one’s own accord; adj., masc. nom. sg.: ’willingly’
ἔθηκε: τίθημι — put, place, cause, bring about; aor. 3 sg., augmented (root θη-/θε-, consonant-initial; unaugmented θῆκε): ’set, caused’ (ἔριν ἔθηκε ’set strife’)
ἔκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; prep. + gen. · also preverb in tmesis (ἔκ … ἐρέω = ἐξερέω ’I shall speak out’)
ἔμελλε: μέλλω — be about to, be destined to (+ inf.); impf. 3 sg.: ’was about to’
ἔμμεναι: εἰμί — be; pres. inf., epic (= Attic εἶναι)
ἔνδοθι: ἔνδοθι — within, inside; adv., with the locative suffix -θι
ἔπειθ: ἔπειτα — then, thereafter; adv., elided (ἔπειθ’ = ἔπειτα before a rough breathing)
ἔπειτ: ἔπειτα (elided ἔπειτ’) — then, next, after that
ἔπειτα: ἔπειτα — then, next, after that; adv.
ἔπος: ἔπος — word, speech, thing said; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἔργα: ἔργον — deed, work; neut. nom./acc. pl. · also ’tilled land, farmland’ (ἔργα νέμοντο ’inhabited the farmlands’)
ἔργον: ἔργον — deed, work, task; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἔσσεται: εἰμί — be; fut. 3 sg., epic doubled σ (= Attic ἔσται)
ἔτ: ἔτι — still, any longer, further; adv., elided (ἔτ’); οὐδ’ ἔτ’ ’nor any more’
ἔφατ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented, elided (ἔφατ’ = ἔφατο)
ἔχει: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. 3 sg. · also intransitive with an adverb, ’be in a state’: εὖ … κομιδὴ ἔχει ’the tending is in good order’
ἔχουσι: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. 3 pl. act.: ’they hold’
ἕκτορα: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. acc. sg.
ἕκτορος: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam, chief Trojan hero; masc. gen. sg.
ἕκτωρ: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. nom. sg.
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj.; ἢ … ἤ ’either … or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative · also introducing the first alternative of an indirect question: ’whether’ (ἢ ἐτεὸν … ἦε ’whether truly … or’) · also after πρίν, ’before’ (πρίν γ’ ἢ ’before …’) · also in τί ἢ δέ, a form of τίη δέ: ’why then’
ἣ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form) · also demonstrative, ’she’ (ἣ δ’ … βεβήκει) · also demonstrative in the correlative ἣ μὲν … ἣ δέ: ’one … another’
ἥδε: ὅδε, ἥδε, τόδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., fem. nom. sg.
ἦ: ἦ — truly, surely; affirming particle; ἦ μέν in oaths · also an interrogative particle · also ἠμί — say; impf. 3 sg. ἦ ’he said’, in ἦ καί, ἦ ῥα · also ἦ = ἤ, ’or’ (εἰ … ἦ ’whether … or’)
ἦλθον: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. 1 sg. (the same ending serves 3 pl.): ’I came’
ἦμαρ: ἦμαρ — day (epic for ἡμέρα); neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἰάχων: ἰάχω — cry out, shout; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic: ’crying out’
ἰδὲ: ἰδέ — and; epic conj. (= Attic καί)
ἰδὼν: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ἰδών): ’seeing, looking’
ἰλίου: Ἴλιος — Ilios, Troy; fem. gen. sg.
ἰοῦσα: εἶμι — go; pres. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’going’
ἱπποδάμων: ἱππόδαμος — horse-taming; adj., masc. gen. pl.
ἱρὴ: ἱρός — holy, sacred; fem. nom. sg., Ionic/epic (= Attic ἱερά)
ἱστὸν: ἱστός — loom, mast; masc. acc. sg. (here ’loom’, and by extension the web on it) · also ’mast’ (of a ship): ἱστὸν … στῆσαν ἀείραντες ’they raised and set up the mast’
ἴλιον: Ἴλιος — Ilios, Troy; fem. acc. sg.
ἴλιος: Ἴλιος — Ilios, Troy; fem. nom. sg.
ἴομεν: εἶμι — go; pres. subj. 1 pl., hortatory: ’let us go’
ἵκανε: ἱκάνω — come to, reach; impf. 3 sg.: ’came to, reached’
ἵππουριν: ἵππουρις — with a horsehair plume; adj., fem. acc. sg.
ἶφι: ἶφι — mightily, by force; adv. (instrumental -φι of ἴς)
ὀλώλῃ: ὄλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish; perf. subj. 3 sg. (ὄλωλα), after ὅτ’ ἄν: ’shall have perished’
ὀνόμαζε: ὀνομάζω — call by name, speak; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ὠνόμαζε); ἔκ τ’ ὀνόμαζε ’spoke out, named’ in tmesis
ὀπίσσω: ὀπίσσω — behind, backward, afterwards; adv. (= ὀπίσω)
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’
ὃν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (masc. acc. sg.)
ὃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also plain demonstrative, ’he’ (ὃς γὰρ δεύτατος ἦλθεν), not a relative
ὄπισθεν: ὄπισθεν — behind, from behind; adv. · also of time: ’afterwards, hereafter’
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., with γε ’he’ · also relative neut. ’which’; ὅ τι ’whatever, why’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of seeing: ’that’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of emotion: ’that, because’ (χωόμενος ὅ τ’ … ’angry that …’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of knowing: ’that’ (ὅ τ’ ἄριστον … οὐδὲν ἔτισεν) · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also masc. nom. sg. ’he’ without γε (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’) · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. sg., ’who’ (ὅ με … κάκ’ ἔοργε ’who did me wrong’)
ὅδε: ὅδε, ἥδε, τόδε — this; demonstrative pron., masc. nom. sg.: ’this’
ὅθ: ὅθι (elided ὅθ’) — where; relative adv. of place · also ὅτε (elided and aspirated ὅθ’) — when; temporal conj.
ὅθι: ὅθι — where; epic relative adverb (= Attic οὗ)
ὅσσον: ὅσος (epic ὅσσος) — as much/great as; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’how much, how far’
ὑπ: ὑπό (elided ὑπ’) — under, beneath; + gen.: ’from under’ (ὑπ’ ἀνθερεῶνος) · also + gen. of the agent or cause, ’under’ (ἀϋσάντων ὑπ’ Ἀχαιῶν ’as the Achaeans shouted’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπ’ Ἀδμήτῳ τέκε ’bore to Admetus’) · also + dat., ’under’ (ὑπ’ ἠελίῳ ’under the sun’) · also + acc. of motion, ’under’ (ὑπ’ ὀστέον ’under the bone’) · also + acc., ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ ἠῶ ’beneath the dawn’)
ὑπὲρ: ὑπέρ — over, beyond; + gen.: ’on behalf of’ (ὑπὲρ Δαναῶν) · also + acc., ’beyond’ (ὑπὲρ αἶσαν ’beyond due measure’) · also + gen. of place, ’above’ (στέρνον ὑπὲρ μαζοῖο ’the breast above the nipple’) · also + acc. of motion, ’over’ (ὑπὲρ ὦμον ’over the shoulder’)
ὑψοῦ: ὑψοῦ — on high, high up; adv.
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’) · also ὡς εἴ, ’as if’ (ὡς εἴ τι κακὸν ῥέζουσαν ’as if doing some evil’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’)
ὥς: ὡς — as; so that; accented ὥς before an enclitic, as in ὥς κε ’so that’ (+ subj.) · also ὥς = ὣς, ’so, thus’, accented before an enclitic (ὥς νύ περ ὧδε ’just so, as now’) · also ὥς κε + subj. in an indirect question: ’how’ (πειρᾶν ὥς κε … ’to try how …’) · also ὡς = ὅτι, ’that’, after a verb of knowing (οἶδα … ὥς ’I know that’) · also ὥς τε, accented before the enclitic τε: ’like, as’ (ὥς τ’ ὄϊες ’like sheep’) · also ὥς κέ + opt., in a wish: ’so (may) …’ · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing a wish with ὄφελ’: ’would that’ (ὥς μ’ ὄφελ’ … ’would that … had …’)
ὧδε: ὧδε — in this place, in this way, thus; adv.
ᾗ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. dat. sg.: ’to whom, whose’ (dat. of the person concerned) · also fem. dat. sg. as a relative adverb of place: ’where, by which way’
ᾧ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative, masc./neut. dat. sg.: ’to whom’ · also possessive, ’his own’
